name: chill-guy-flat-backdrop
prompt: A full-length, eye-level portrait of a lone figure standing dead centre against one seamless, flat backdrop of soft peach-apricot, the same even colour from floor to top edge like a blank meme template. The figure wears a close-fitting knitted balaclava in charcoal wool with no openings at all for eyes, nose or mouth; a thick white ring is stitched round the entire face, and high inside that ring, on the right-hand side of the picture, sits one small red triangle with softly rounded corners, point down. Grey knitted gloves, so no skin shows anywhere. Over the shoulders hangs a baggy, oversized oatmeal cardigan, slightly too long in the sleeves, open over a plain cream tee, with loose khaki cargo trousers bunching at the ankles and chunky off-white trainers. The pose is pure unbothered ease: both gloved hands shoved deep into the cardigan pockets, weight sunk onto one hip, one knee loose, shoulders dropped and rounded, the masked head tipped a few degrees to one side as if quietly amused by everything. Shot straight on with a 50mm-equivalent lens from chest height, whole body from crown to soles in frame, the figure small in the lower-middle with wide bands of empty peach backdrop above and on both sides. Soft, shadowless studio light from a large frontal source, a faint grey contact shadow pooling at the feet, gentle matte texture on the knit. Palette of peach, oatmeal, khaki, charcoal and white, with the single red accent on the mask. No text, no lettering, no logos anywhere. Thanks.
